brand.tagline: A calm, private career navigator for people whose work is being reshaped by AI.
home.title: The work is changing. You can change with it.
home.sub: Tell us what you do in 90 seconds. Get a calm read on your industry and a dated plan to grow.
home.steps.title: A wish with a deadline is a goal. A goal with a plan is a strategy.
home.b1.d: New and changing roles ranked by how well your experience fits, each with an honest gap analysis.
home.b2: What is happening, in plain words
home.b2.d: Recent articles from Irish and European sources, each with one line on what it means for you.
home.b3.d: Weekly tasks sized to your time, with the courses, jobs and people that move you forward.
home.b3.cal: Add every task to Google, Outlook or Apple Calendar
home.b3.jobs: Jobs posted in the last 48 hours, pre-filtered
home.b3.posts: LinkedIn post drafts tied to your milestones
demo.title: See it through someone else's eyes
demo.aoife.name: Aoife, software developer in Dublin
demo.aoife.story: Worried AI will flatten her job. Discovers her support and fintech background makes her a strong fit for Forward Deployed Engineer.
demo.oksana.name: Оксана, accountant in Cork
demo.oksana.story: Nine years of IFRS experience in Kharkiv, new to Ireland. Gets her whole plan in Ukrainian, with Irish funded courses.
home.trust.title: Private by design. Open by default.
home.trust.1: No account and no tracking. Your profile stays in this browser, and you can delete it in one tap.
home.trust.2: Runs on Gemma 4, an open-weight model, right on this computer through Ollama. Your answers never leave the machine.
home.trust.3: Seven languages, including Gaeilge, Polski and Українська, for the people who keep Ireland working.
home.trust.4: Every course and news link is real and checked. The AI is not allowed to invent URLs.
home.final: Ninety seconds to a clearer next step.
